definitions.explanation: A strategy board game in which two players alternate placing stones on a grid, aiming to be the first to get five of their stones in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.

examples.japanese: {五目並|ごもくなら}べ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{五目並|ごもくなら}べ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I often played five in a row.

examples.english: Gomoku is a game you can easily enjoy using a go board and stones.

notes:
USAGE:
A simple strategy game that can be played on any grid. Traditionally played using go stones and a go board. Popular as a casual game among all ages in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {五目並|ごもくなら}べ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to play gomoku)
- {五目並|ごもくなら}べ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ (to win at gomoku)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧: go (the strategic board game)
- ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧: shogi (Japanese chess)
- {連珠|れんじゅ}: renju (competitive variant of gomoku with official rules)
